# Enable toolkit

Read the [profile](../../../docs/project-profile.md) and
[standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md). Map needed capabilities to existing
tools before proposing another product.

For relevant gaps, consult current official vendor documentation and record source,
date/version, applicability, alternatives, invocation and limitations. Missing web
access means research is Unverified. Optional improvements are not mandatory gaps.

Request explicit scoped authorisation before installation, upgrade, authentication,
paid service, source upload or configuration changes. Never expose credentials.
After authorised setup, execute a bounded check and distinguish this machine from
CI. Proposal, research and setup permission are not successful tool evidence or G0.

Output: profile toolkit section with actual results and owned Unverified gaps.
